name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted algorithmic trading platform with a unified REST API, live market data WebSocket and web dashboard for Indian brokers.

alerts.message: Open the app right after deployment: the first account created on the setup page becomes the only admin. Then add your broker API key and secret under Broker Configuration and register https://<your-domain>/<broker>/callback as the redirect URL in your broker's developer console.
API_KEY_PEPPER and FERNET_SALT hash the login password and encrypt the stored broker keys and tokens. Back them up and never change them after the first start, or the saved data becomes unreadable.
